exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with one previous cesarean delivery undergoing TOLAC at term between 2007 and 2014 (n=2849)
finding: Gestational age at delivery was not found to be an independent risk factor for TOLAC success or uterine rupture in women at term with a single previous cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Gestational age at delivery was not found to be an independent risk factor for successful trial of labor after cesarean delivery or uterine rupture in women at term with a single previous cesarean delivery.
